title: QuantAtlas-OM: Taming Neural Spectral Bias in Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Ocean Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.24124v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive neural networks exhibit spectral bias in long-horizon spatiotemporal prediction. As rollouts progress, high-frequency details decay, blurring the predicted fields and destabilizing long-range forecasts. Ocean dynamics offer a particularly stringent test because kinetic energy is concentrated in mesoscale eddies and fronts spanning tens of kilometers. This degradation stems from coupling large-scale phase evolution and small-scale energy retention in a shared feature space. Evolution on a coarse grid smooths out high-wavenumber eddies, whereas evolution on a fine grid amplifies small-scale phase errors and triggers rollout instability. We introduce QuantAtlas-OM (QuantAtlas Ocean Model), a scale-spectral decoupling framework that confines deep temporal evolution to a low-wavenumber latent manifold for long-term stability while routing full-resolution eddy and front residuals through an outer bypass to the decoder. translated_title: QuantAtlas-OM：驯服长时程时空海洋动力学中的神经频谱偏差
translated_abstract: 自回归神经网络在长时程时空预测中表现出频谱偏差。随着滚动预测的推进，高频细节逐渐衰减，导致预测场变得模糊，并使长期预报失去稳定性。海洋动力学为这一难题提供了尤为严苛的测试场景，因为其动能集中在跨度达数十公里的中尺度涡旋和锋面上。这种性能退化源于大尺度相位演化与小尺度能量保持被耦合在同一个共享特征空间中：在粗网格上演化会平滑掉高波数的涡旋，而在细网格上演化则会放大小尺度相位误差并引发滚动预测的不稳定性。我们提出QuantAtlas-OM（QuantAtlas海洋模型），这是一个尺度-频谱解耦框架，它将深度时间演化限制在低波数潜在流形上以保证长期稳定性，同时通过外部旁路将全分辨率的涡旋和锋面残差传递至解码器。
tldr: 提出尺度-频谱解耦框架QuantAtlas-OM，将时间演化约束在低波数潜在流形以保证长时程稳定性，同时通过外部旁路保留全分辨率涡旋与锋面残差，从而解决自回归海洋预测中的神经频谱偏差问题。
en_tdlr: QuantAtlas-OM introduces a scale-spectral decoupling framework that confines deep temporal evolution to a low-wavenumber latent manifold for long-term stability while routing full-resolution eddy and front residuals through an outer bypass to the decoder, thereby taming neural spectral bias in long-horizon spatiotemporal ocean dynamics prediction.
